lines: Alaska'da bir kuş havalanıyor ve on bir gün boyunca hiç inmeyecek.
On üç bin kilometreden fazla, tek seferde.
Yolculuktan önce vücudunun büyük kısmı yağa dönüşür.
Sindirim organları küçülür, uçuşa yer açılır.
Ve bir sonraki baharda, aynı yolu geri döner.

acts.why: the take-off and the bird itself: a loud field poster, the camera whips in
the route: a night navigation chart, calm and wide
inside the body: a technical plate, drifting slowly, typed notes
the return closes in the opening poster

ideas: The flock lifting off; the camera whips onto it and the words slam in
The godwit as a labelled specimen: the barred tail, the long bill
The whole Pacific at night; an arc grows from Alaska to New Zealand
Thirteen thousand kilometres slams over open ocean seen from above
Fat equals fuel: two words as a formula
Before and in flight in two window cards with a VS badge
Half a ring: almost half the body weight gone on landing
The same chart in daylight; the arc drawn back north
